features.title: Lights across the street
features.text: Every Claude Code session is a lit window in the city behind the rain: green is working, amber is waiting for you, blue is done.

features.title: Look outside (Ctrl+Tab)
features.text: Your windows step back, every light shows its session and status – click one to jump straight in.

features.title: Faster, and no Node.js needed
features.text: The bridge to Claude Code is now a small Rust program: hooks start about 6× faster, each session needs a tenth of the memory, and you no longer have to install Node.js.

features.title: The night design of this website
features.text: Night blue instead of black, color only for status, Instrument Sans for people and JetBrains Mono for the machine.

features.title: Tool windows Claude builds for you
features.text: Ask Claude for a small window – a todo board, a status view – and it builds it in VibeDesk's look.

features.title: A memory you can see
features.text: The brain shows what Claude knows about your project, as a graph or as files, with a log of what it read and learned.

features.title: Character rain
features.text: The rain of this website as a background: drops made of characters, and your mouse is an umbrella.
